verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints that AutoGen is model-agnostic. A community user reportedly pointed it at GPT-4 "and other LLMs", and the install line pulls a provider-specific extension (`autogen-ext[openai]`), which suggests pluggable model backends. No documentation shows swapping a provider or model while leaving agent code unchanged. Missing for 10: first-party docs on a pluggable model-client abstraction, a list of supported providers, a documented example of swapping models without rewriting the agent, and independent hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can swap the underlying LLM provider or model without rewriting my agent
